In-class Assignment

Extract JSON data from The Open Movie Database API based on your own query http://www.omdbapi.com (you will have to register for a free API key)

Create a data dictionary for the extracted data and save it as a .Rmd file named data-dictionary-open-movie-database-api.Rmd

Now, create a data dictionary for each data in the data-and-sources.Rmd file and save each as a .Rmd file named data-dictionary-{data-name}.Rmd where {data-name} is the name of the data file before the provider information and without the extension and without curly braces. For example, for the "Shipping Arrivals at Cape of Good Hope provided by IMF Portwatch and Oxford University" data, the file should be named data-dictionary-shipping-arrivals-at-cape-of-good-hope.Rmd.

#api key: b6c9c053

```{r, echo = TRUE}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
omdb <- GET('http://www.omdbapi.com/?apikey=b6c9c053&t=Batman')|>
  content(as = 'text', encoding = 'UTF-8')|>
  fromJSON(flatten =TRUE)

str(omdb)
```
